usedFor: Bluesky holds posts and MSG91 holds your support desk, so “New Post with Search Options” can open a ticket.

bestTemplate.name: “New Post with Search Options” in Bluesky, then “Send Mail via Hello” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: A post that matches your search becomes a ticket, so a public mention gets a person to answer it.

watchOut: “New Post with Search Options” is polling, so tickets open after a scheduled check and may lag the post.
